name: Story & Theatre of the World
subtitle: Yoke thé, Karagoz & more
shortDescription: 10 theatre and storytelling traditions to play: Wayang Shadow Puppets, Water puppet pond theatre, Yoke thé marionette theatre and String Marionette Theatre.
longDescription:
Story & Theatre of the World: 10 theatre and storytelling traditions from 12 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Wayang Shadow Puppets, Water puppet pond theatre, Yoke thé marionette theatre, String Marionette Theatre, Karagoz, Aragoz hand-puppet booth, Bayt-bazi verse chain, Kathputli string puppets, Sahel salt caravan and Hira gasy troupe contest.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can perform stories and theatre, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
